title: Scalar restriction of the normalized open projection
statement: Fix any presentations $m$ and normalized comparison choices $c$ [def-sp-open-scalar-tensor-data]. Suppose for each finite commutative ring $A$ and open immersion $j:U\to X$ [def-weil-open-immersion] a natural forward projection isomorphism $\gamma^A:(j_!^AK)\otimes_A^LQ\cong j_!^A(K\otimes_A^Lj_A^{-1}Q)$ is supplied, whose inverse is the open adjunct of the open unit tensor the identity followed by the inverse canonical restriction tensorator. For every map of finite commutative rings $\varphi:A\to B$, the specified mate $\rho:j_!^A\operatorname{Res}_U\to\operatorname{Res}_Xj_!^B$ is invertible, and the specified scalar projection $s$ identifies the scalar-restricted $\beta$ with $\gamma^A$ at the B coefficient: $s_X;\operatorname{Res}_X(\beta_K)=\gamma^A_{K,B_X};j_!^A((1\otimes\text{coefficientPullback});s_U);\rho_{S_UK}$. The equality uses exactly the coefficient pullback determined by the identity-on-actions square and the chosen open unit comparison, for arbitrary unbounded $K,Q$.

proof.text: The supplied inverse-adjunct equation uniquely identifies each projection with the canonical open projection. Scalar restriction changes only actions on the open extension presheaf, and hence commutes with its sheafification. Its invertible identity comparison obeys the open-unit equation, which identifies it with the specified mate restrictionOpen.

The scalar and open Hom bijections identify restricted inverse beta with inverse projection at the B unit: on K-flat representatives each scalar unit inserts 1, and the pullback comparison retains B. Naturality of the normalized open unit provides coefficientPullback. Equality of adjuncts after representative descent gives equality of the inverse maps, then inversion gives restricted_beta.
